summary: Removed enhanced-tag create/delete entirely (spec, generated command files, MCP tool registrations, tools-manifest.json, README.md, SKILL.md). enhanced-tag list is unaffected.
reason: A maintainer-requested live write-side smoke test (real OURA_ACCESS_TOKEN) showed POST /v2/usercollection/enhanced_tag returns HTTP 405 Method Not Allowed with an `Allow: GET` response header, confirmed independently via both the CLI and a raw curl probe. The Allow header indicates the live Oura v2 API does not support write methods on this resource for any caller, not an auth/scope issue. The hand-authored spec assumed full CRUD (list/create/delete) based on documentation that does not match the live API's actual behavior, so create/delete were research-time errors rather than reachable endpoints; shipping them would mean commands that always fail.
validated_outcome: go build/vet/test pass after removal; enhanced-tag --help now shows only the list subcommand. webhook-subscription create was also tested live in the same pass and confirmed to correctly require x-client-id/x-client-secret (401), matching the PR's existing documented gap — no change needed there.
